sentences.text: The Home Loan Agreement’s Schedule II includes a documentation fee of ₹500, payable once at execution.
The only code-verified RBI rule found for fees not in the KFS permits such fees only if the stated conditions are met, but its applicability is still unknown because the sanction date is missing.
On the present record, I cannot confirm that the documentation fee clause complies with the RBI’s current rules because the relevant rule’s applicability has not been established.

missing.searched: Needed to determine whether the RBI rule on fees not in the KFS applies to this loan.
